name: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure
original_name: 悠久の愚者アズリーの、賢者のすゝめ
overview: After accidentally gaining immortality from the “Eternity Elixir,” Asley spends 5,000 years mastering ancient magic before setting out on a journey with his loyal familiar, Pochi—beginning a timeless, offbeat fantasy adventure.
